title: Finite finitely presented pushforward preserves constructible etale modules
statement: Let $X,Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of finite presentation, meaning locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. If $F$ is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], then the direct image $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $Y_{\Et}$.

source.place: Tag 095R, label lemma-finite-pushforward-constructible, finite-ring and qcqs specialization
